synopsis.text: A Wakandan facility is being attacked, as Black Panther attempts to defend it. Firestar and Justice are moving into the mansion, as Thor, Captain America, and Iron Man are having a press conference. Wasp crashes in the window talking about Giant-Man being kidnapped. Scarlet Witch and Wonder Man are at a club, where Wanda is dancing. They all gather together and head towards Wakanda, where Alkhema is attacking Black Panther. With the help of Scarlet Witch, the Avengers defeat her, only to see Ultron attacking Slorenia.
